title: Sarman challenge - Aaron Maher vs Mykeltik klink
tactical_note: Aaron Maher's grappling in this match involves a strong stance with a high level of stability and control, with a significant amount of ground/scrabble work and a high spine lean. The mean spine lean is particularly noteworthy, with the elbow flexion being particularly strong, indicating a high level of control and power. The knee flexion is also notable, with a relatively high range of motion. This match showcases Maher's ability to execute a high level of grappling with a high degree of control and precision.
